test.create(count)
test.set_value(count, 4)
test.create(first_total)
test.execute(operation<my.domain.com:my_lib:/difference>, count, 1, first_total)
test.create(/final_result)
test.execute(operation<my.domain.com:my_lib:/difference>, first_total, 2, /final_result)
test.destroy(count)
test.destroy(first_total)
